## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical handling of real-world imperfections (clock drift) before ICA. Emphasizes lightweight, real-time steps and concrete evaluation.

## Key Concepts
- Per-channel alignment and resampling to a common rate
- Lightweight whitening suitable for online use
- Online 4×4 demixing with periodic updates

- Ground-truth based SDR/SIR evaluation

## Code Example

// Pseudo: alignment + whitening + online ICA loop
function processFrame(frames) {
  const aligned = alignChannels(frames); // cross-corr peak, resample
  const whitened = whiten(aligned);
  const demixed = onlineICAUpdate(whitened);

}
